# Verse & Voice

> Live one-to-one online Quran classes for kids and teens (about age 4 and up), taught by voice with a teacher who listens. Families in the USA, Canada, the Gulf (Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia), the UK and worldwide. Courses: Noorani Qaida, Quran reading with tajweed, Quran memorisation (hifz), namaz (how to pray), and stories of the Prophets. The first class is a free trial.

Key facts:
- Format: one teacher, one child, live, by voice. No camera needed.
- In class the child's Qaida or Quran page follows the teacher's page in the kids' portal.
- Age groups: Little Readers 4-8, Young Reciters 9-13, Teens 14+.
- Class times are agreed in the family's own time zone (US and Canadian time zones, Gulf time, UK time); after-school evening classes for North America.
- Parents see attendance and para-by-para progress and receive a monthly report.
- Fees are monthly and can be paid in local currency (USD, CAD, BHD, KWD, QAR, AED, OMR, SAR, GBP); contact for current fees.
- Booking: WhatsApp +92 331 0438768, Instagram @verseandvoicequran, Facebook /verseandvoicequran.
